text:
maria: Support hit a weird one: customer rotated presigned upload URLs at the same time they migrated from redwood-embed-v1 -> redwood-embed-v2. For ~2-3 minutes embeddings calls returned 401s. Text-gen calls ok.

chris: Only presigned URLs rotated, no API key change?

maria: Correct. Their batch job updated the model field as soon as they rotated URLs; requests included old presigned links and failed with 401 signature mismatch. Fresh presign + retry fixed it.

jun: Sounds like a race between short-lived credentials and model rollout. We should call this out in the model-swap migration guide.

chris: Proposed doc change: new subsection under "Model swap checklist" titled "Short-lived credentials and referenced assets" with bullets: issue new presigned URLs and ensure clients refresh references before swap; invalidate client caches; run a post-swap smoke test hitting embeddings per region.

maria: I'll add a short JS snippet showing safe order: request presign -> upload -> call embeddings, and a retry-on-401 flow that re-fetches presign and retries once.

jun: Also add a note about older SDKs that send `model_hint`. Recommend explicit model names during migration and link to runtime routing doc.

chris: SDK migration guide should include the retry/backoff example and explain that transient 401s may happen when infra rotates short-lived credentials.

docs-bot: PR opened: github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2351 by maria (draft: "Model swap: presigned assets & auth race condition") :eyes:

maria: pinging @chris @jun for quick review. I'll also add an internal SRE checklist for a 1-user smoke test per region post-swap.

chris: Good catch, thanks support.

jun: Quick copy nits only.

maria: Will close thread when the PR merges. :white_check_mark:
